semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides essential fasteners and logistics solutions tailored for semiconductor manufacturing and assembly processes.
summary: LPS Bossard Pvt. Ltd. specializes in supplying a wide range of fasteners and logistics solutions specifically designed for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include over 200,000 different standard and branded fasteners, such as screws, which are crucial for semiconductor manufacturing and assembly. They also provide application engineering services to optimize fastening solutions, enhancing production efficiency and reliability.
capabilities: Standard and branded fasteners for semiconductor manufacturing
Logistics solutions to reduce total cost of ownership
Application engineering services for fastening optimization
